caption: Kar. 121.  Spout of Altar on Pl. 29
notes: Only lines 1, 7, 8, 14, 15, 21, 22 are numbered; thin wavy lines (cracks or joins) cross several signs and thin vertical bars stand at the line numbers 8, 15, 22. Line 1: last sign is a single slash crossed by a crack, read y? (could be o or a part of y). Line 7: first sign is a 2 with long tail right of a crack and an S left of it, read together as a (could be e plus a lost sign); n has a long tail running under the S. 'k?o' in line 7: a flat-topped 3 between two slashes, k or q+o. Line 8: sign after ḫ is a flat-topped loop crossed by a crack, w?; next word: right sign is a V with a T-bar (b?) beside a 4 (i?), then flat-topped 3 with long tail (k), Sigma with long tail (p), S crossed by crack (e?). Line 14: the 3 has a long tail (s, could be ẖ); next two hook signs read l? and l. Line 15: 'te' is slash + hook with bar (could be l + o). Line 21: k e te clear. ḫmlo(22)l parallels Kar. 122 line 13 and Kar. 123 line 8; the 3 there could be s. Line 22: last trace is a horizontal stroke cut by a crack, written [.]. Sign after o in 'solke' is l (small hook).
check_notes: Placed: formula C table and prose (ḫmlol : ẖolke-), Index B 'ant : boqḫw : dik : pedemeyotito' with Index C boqḫw, dik, pedemeyotito (only 'pe' of the last survives before the crack), Index A 'roslleb' and Index B 'roẖ?eleb' (line 14), names table 'lost' (the name after soreyi is lost on the copy). Not placed: pesetoleb yetmdelowi (three entries plus Index C yetmdelowi; not on the surviving copy, presumably in the lost lines 2-6, 9-13 or 16-20) and the cf. entry for Kar. 47. Index A and Index B print line 14 differently (A: r o s l l e b; B: r o ẖ/m e l e b); the copy agrees with A. Formula C table prints ẖolke[te]; the copy shows only a trace after e, kept as [.]. The copy shows no divider between dik and pe, though Index B prints one.

caption: Kar. 123.  Altar
reading: (1)w?osi : (2)soreyi : (3)m?qoslwteror(4)qo : soni : mnipselo : s[.][.][.]i?[.][.](5)mnpselo : soni : mn(6)pselo : m?lo(7)lo : ḫ(8)mlol : ẖo(9)lkte : nmli(10)tedḫlo : [.]slẖ?s : terekelo :
notes: The copy has two columns; the line numbers run right column then left column on each row (1-2 right, 3-4 left, 5 left of row 2, 6 right of row 3, 7 left of row 3, 8-9 row 4 right, 10 row 5 right), so it is read row by row, right half then left half. Row 2 right and row 3 right have no line number of their own (row 3's small mark over p may be 6). Line 1: w hatched. Line 3: first sign 3 with long tail (ẖ?); '/9/' read q+o. Line 4 'qo' as in Kar. 122. 'soni': slash stands left of the 3, so could be q; the 4 after n may be the rising stroke of n drawn as a 4 (also in 'mnip'); in row 3 a further upright stroke stands by the 4. 'mnip/mnp': the 3 with long tail read m (could be ẖ). Row 2 left: after the first 3 a hatched stretch of about five signs with traces (a tail at its right end, a 4 in the middle). Row 3 right: n hatched. Row 3 left: first sign hatched (l?). Line 8: first sign a cup with a hook (ḫ?, could be to). Line 9: 'so' could be q. Line 10: the first sign of row 5 left is a thin hatched stretch ([.]); a hatched B-like sign (a slash and 3) read q?; the hatched sign after the divider with the slash read te?; 'rekelo' has S (e) where terikelo would have i. 'nm?l?i?': the H-like sign read i?.
check_notes: All 15 entries placed. soni : mn(i)pselo three times (rows 2 and 3); the type brackets the i, which the copy shows in the first occurrence only; Index B prints mnpselowi, the copy has mnpselo : with no wi. mlolowi placed on line 7 (m?lo(7)lo; the copy has no wi there and the first sign is hatched). Names table A m(?)qoslwterorqo, B nmli, C slẖs/slms (title) with terekelo. The typings disagree on the third sign of slẖs (names table and Index A m, Index B and C ẖ); the copy sign is hatched, so it stays ẖ?.
